page_title: LEV 0-0 BAY | Bayer Leverkusen v Bayern Munich 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
90+5' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90+4' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked for saying more than Daniel Siebert was willing to tolerate.

90+4' Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save! Now Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
90+3' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Alejandro Grimaldo.

90+2' A rebound falls to Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.

90+2' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Manuel Neuer, who pulls off a stunning save!
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
88' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for an infringement.
87' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is flagged for offside.
86' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Jamal Musiala and he is replaced by Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich).

85' The attendance is 30210.
85' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
83' A pass from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Manuel Neuer and the move breaks down.

81' What a chance that is! Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!
78' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
76' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
75' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
74' A yellow card for a tackle by Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich). Daniel Siebert doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
74' Bayern Munich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked. Bayern Munich win a corner.
73' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
72' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
69' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.

66' The referee awards a corner and Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take it.

65' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) whips the ball into the box and Florian Wirtz takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
62' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) launches a cross from the corner, but Manuel Neuer is alert to thwart the effort.
62' A cross from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.

59' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
59' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
59' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) serves up a nice cross, but Manuel Neuer punches the ball away. The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner.
58' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.

53' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
52' PENALTY APPEAL after Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
50' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.

35' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
33' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) slams the ball goalwards from 50 metres out, but his decent effort flies a whisker wide of the right post.

25' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
22' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) blows an opportunity from close range as he heads a rebound onto to the crossbar!

21' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Manuel Neuer allowed him to make a comfortable save.
20' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

20' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.

18' What a great touch by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
18' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) jumps into a tackle and Daniel Siebert signals a foul.

9' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
8' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniel Siebert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
